_doc: The Ember Forge. Materials drop from kills (chance), chests and bosses and are collected by walking over them. Every item rolls Heat (forging potential) by rarity; each craft spends a random amount of it (`heat` range) and nothing can be done once it runs out. Uniques and set pieces cannot be forged. Refunds at Ottilie's ledger cost Ash.

ash.name: Ash
ash.text: Common soot from the Dusk. Pays for refunds at the order's ledger.

kindle.name: Kindle Ember
kindle.text: Adds a new affix at tier 1 (up to two prefixes and two suffixes).

temper.name: Temper Ember
temper.text: Raises one affix a tier (up to tier 5) and rerolls it in the new tier.

anneal.name: Anneal Ember
anneal.text: Rerolls the values of every affix within its tier.
